title: Browse background alternate palettes
changes: Browse both alternate background palette catalogs by descriptor, environment low bits and bank, with stored color words and source references.
Apply the selected alternate bank to background tile sheets and navigate between views; show 0xFF keys as unavailable.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-alternate-palettes-synthetic-pl5eja0m passed catalog validation, colors, sentinel handling, links and standalone resource checks in Linux Chrome.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-alternate-palettes-eur-y5byo3lu matched 314 palettes, 40,192 color words and descriptor links, then checked a real swatch, tile pixel and unavailable key in Chrome.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-alternate-palettes-docker-0kqk3x86 matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: Catalog selections do not reproduce live palette effects or a complete scene. Native Windows and other preview families remain open.
